audit_note: CRITICAL BUG CONFIRMED: In chb01_03.edf, the single verified seizure occurs from 2996s to 3036s. A chronological 60%/20%/20% split places the seizure ENTIRELY inside the test partition (2440s to 3050s). The training partition has 0 seizure windows (366 non-seizure), and the validation partition has 0 seizure windows (122 non-seizure). Therefore, a supervised binary model CANNOT be trained or threshold-calibrated on this split. The previous run artificially split the 8 positive windows 4/2/2, causing intra-event temporal leakage across partitions.
